description: Structural quality gates for converted research-paper Markdown used by retrieval, citations, reader-open targets, and the literature basket.

cases.title: SCINeRF CVPR paper keeps title, abstract, figures, tables, equations, and references
cases.md_path: db/CVPR-2024-SCINeRF- Neural Radiance Fields from a Snapshot Compressive Image/CVPR-2024-SCINeRF- Neural Radiance Fields from a Snapshot Compressive Image.en.md

must_contain_text: SCINeRF: Neural Radiance Fields from a Snapshot Compressive Image

cases.title: NatCommun single-photon paper keeps abstract, figure/table density, math, and references
cases.md_path: db/NatCommun-2023-High-resolution single-photon imaging with physics-informed deep learning/NatCommun-2023-High-resolution single-photon imaging with physics-informed deep learning.en.md

must_contain_text: High-resolution single-photon imaging with physics-informed deep learning

cases.title: Image denoising review keeps section structure, formulas, table, and long bibliography

must_contain_text: Brief review of image denoising techniques
